description: Prompts a Gemma 4 chat template renders for text-only requests, recorded from vLLM's own server: `ids` is the engine's POST /tokenize (messages, add_generation_prompt, the same chat_template_kwargs) and `text` the prompt those ids spell. Every layout with a string system or developer message ends its system turn in a space: vLLM hands the template the string as a one-item text part list and the template's parts branch appends a space after every part.
